reason: No physical appliance has been enrolled and no live field trial has been performed in this checkout. Synthetic fixtures, imported WAVs, the seeded reference fan and browser fake-device tests do not count as field evidence.
requiredForClosure: Create or choose an object that is not the synthetic reference fan.
Record at least two live idle, two live operating and one live background take from the actual microphone, then train a READY USER_CALIBRATION model.
Perform the guided three-cycle ON/OFF trial plus the separate noise, distance and replay trials with the physical appliance.
Generate a server-evaluated FIELD_PASS report and preserve its report id, model hash, evidence hash and public JSON.
Have a named reviewer confirm the physical object, microphone, date and actions, and record that confirmation here.
closureRule: Gate H may close only when a FIELD_PASS report exists for the active model hash, all four live trials are present, the report is inspectable, and a named reviewer confirms the physical evidence. A failed gate must remain failed; synthetic or imported audio cannot be substituted.
